title: Digital Marketer
description:
Attention: Talented marketers who want to feel appreciated, valued and part of something worthwhile!

Warning! This job advert isn't like others you've seen and there's a good reason for that.

I'll get to it shortly

Whether you're stuck, stagnating or just starting out, getting a rewarding job in the digital marketing industry isn't always easy.

In fact, since the explosion of AI, just knowing how to DO online marketing is no longer enough.

Being part of a team that can 'pinpoint' exactly how to make marketing work and achieve jaw-dropping results is the best way to fulfil your potential, accelerate your marketing career and love the job you do each day.

If you're the kind of online marketer who can't rest until your copy is compelling, your campaigns are neatly named and even your wardrobe is ordered by the colours of the electromagnetic spectrum (ok, perhaps a little too far!).

If you set goals, have a thirst for knowledge, do what you say, when you say then we like the cut of your jib!

Your day-to-day activities will include:
- Generating and analysing monthly marketing reports
- Hosting customer monthly and quarterly marketing meetings
- Communicating directly with customers
- Completing all monthly marketing work for each of your customers
- Planning and managing monthly SEO work
- Planning and creating blog posts and content ideas
- Google Ads management and optimisation
- Social media management and content creation
- Facebook Ads management and optimisation
- Bing Ads management and optimisation
- Planning and management of customer monthly offer campaigns
- Scheduling and managing daily and weekly workflows
- Weekly performance reporting
- Attending daily and weekly team meetings
- Upselling for growing marketing campaigns

You'll get the keys to our Pandora's box of proven marketing tools, the freedom to use them, and the backing to deliver results most marketers only dream about.

Here's What To Do Next

Scroll to the top of this advert and click on the pink 'Apply now' button to be taken to our special page, which has all the details.

Whenever we do this, we get a lot of interest as you might expect.

Don't put this off, take the easy next step towards the marketing career you deserve and apply for your 'work from home' internet marketing job by 5pm on Thursday 26 November 2026.

P.S Just to make sure you have the right skills

This role is perfect for anyone who is or is looking to progress as a digital marketer, online marketer, internet marketer, social media marketer, junior marketer, marketing assistant, marketing coordinator, marketing executive, marketing manager or anyone who has an eye for creating marketing that works.

ALSO, you don't need any past work experience or qualifications, just passion and a good eye for marketing and business growth.

Easily apply for this exciting digital marketing position (no past job experience or qualifications needed) by clicking the pink 'Apply now' button.

Stay Awesome.

title: Group Marketing Executive
company: Macildowie Recruitment and Retention - Agency - Permanent
description:
Group Marketing Executive
Loughborough, Leicestershire
£30,000 - £35,000 per annum
Monday to Friday, Hybrid

We are recruiting for a creative, commercially minded and proactive Group Marketing Executive to join a growing B2 B client based in Loughborough.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced Marketing Executive looking to take the next step in their career, working across multiple brands within a wider group structure.

You'll play an important role in delivering engaging, effective marketing campaigns that strengthen brand awareness, generate leads and support wider commercial objectives. Working closely with key stakeholders across the business, you'll have the opportunity to get involved in a broad mix of marketing activities, from digital campaigns and content creation through to brand development, events and marketing communications.

This is a varied, hands-on position that would suit someone who enjoys taking ownership, bringing fresh ideas to the table and seeing their work make a genuine impact.

Key Responsibilities
- Marketing Strategy & Campaign Delivery
- Support the planning, development and execution of integrated marketing campaigns across multiple brands within the group.
- Work closely with internal stakeholders to understand commercial priorities and translate these into effective marketing activity.
- Coordinate campaigns across digital and traditional channels, ensuring consistent messaging and brand positioning.
- Monitor campaign performance, providing insights and recommendations to improve engagement and return on investment.
- Support the delivery of new product launches, promotional initiatives and wider business projects.
- Digital Marketing & Content Creation
- Create engaging content for websites, social media, email campaigns, blogs and marketing collateral.
- Manage and maintain social media channels, developing content calendars and driving audience engagement.
- Support the development and execution of email marketing campaigns, including audience segmentation and performance tracking.
- Update and optimise website content, ensuring information remains accurate, engaging and aligned with SEO best practices.
- Work with external agencies and suppliers where required to support digital marketing activity.
- Brand Management & Communications
- Help maintain a consistent brand identity and tone of voice across all marketing channels and group businesses.
- Produce high-quality marketing materials, including brochures, presentations, case studies and sales support collateral.
- Support internal and external communications, ensuring key messages are communicated effectively.
- Identify opportunities to increase brand visibility and strengthen market positioning.
- Assist with the planning and coordination of exhibitions, events and promotional activities.
- Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement
- Track and analyse marketing performance using relevant analytics and reporting tools.
- Provide regular updates on campaign results, engagement and lead generation.
- Collaborate with sales and wider commercial teams to ensure marketing activity supports business growth.
- Manage multiple projects and deadlines, prioritising effectively across different brands and business requirements.
- Contribute new ideas and recommendations to continuously improve marketing effectiveness.

About You

We're looking for an enthusiastic and well-rounded marketing professional who enjoys variety, takes initiative and is comfortable managing multiple projects.

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous experience in a Marketing Executive, Marketing Coordinator or similar generalist marketing role.
- Experience delivering marketing campaigns across a range of online and offline channels.
- Strong content creation and copywriting skills, with an eye for detail and brand consistency.
- A good understanding of digital marketing, including social media, email marketing, websites and SEO.
- Experience using marketing platforms and tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, Mailchimp, HubSpot, Google Analytics or similar.
- Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
- Confidence working with stakeholders across different departments and levels of seniority.
- A proactive, creative and solutions-focused approach.
- Strong communication skills and a genuine enthusiasm for marketing.

Apply today or get in touch with Macildowie to find out more about this exciting opportunity in Loughborough.

title: Marketing Assistant
description:
Marketing Assistant - Trade & Retail

Location: Leicester
Salary: £30,000-£36,000 DOE
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

The Opportunity

We're recruiting two hands-on Marketing Assistants for an established and growing multi-site business operating across both trade and retail markets.

Working as part of a small, collaborative marketing team, you'll be involved in a broad range of marketing activities, from digital campaigns, social media and content creation through to email marketing, promotional materials and in-store activity.

There are two positions available, each with a slightly different focus:
- Trade Marketing Assistant: Developing and delivering marketing campaigns aimed at trade customers, including installers, contractors and other industry professionals. This will involve product promotions, customer incentives, digital communications and supporting the branch network with marketing activity.
- Retail Marketing Assistant: Creating engaging consumer-facing marketing campaigns, promoting a network of retail showrooms, building brand awareness and driving customer enquiries, showroom appointments and footfall through digital and traditional marketing channels.

Although each role has its own primary focus, we're looking for versatile marketing all-rounders who are comfortable working across different channels, can take ownership of campaigns and bring fresh ideas to the table.

Key Responsibilities
- Plan, coordinate and deliver marketing campaigns across a range of digital and traditional channels.
- Create engaging content for websites, social media, email campaigns and promotional materials.
- Manage and develop social media activity, helping to increase engagement, brand awareness and customer enquiries.
- Produce compelling marketing copy for campaigns, promotions and customer communications.
- Support the development and delivery of product promotions, seasonal campaigns and customer incentives.
- Work closely with internal teams, branches and external partners to ensure marketing activity is delivered effectively.
- Update and maintain website content using content management systems (CMS).
- Assist with the production of brochures, flyers, point-of-sale materials and other marketing collateral.
- Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve engagement and results.
- Contribute new ideas and take ownership of projects from initial concept through to delivery.

About You

We're looking for enthusiastic, commercially minded marketing professionals who enjoy being hands-on and getting things done.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in a Marketing Executive, Marketing Assistant, Marketing Coordinator or similar role.
- Broad practical experience across digital marketing, content creation, social media and email campaigns.
- Strong written communication and copywriting skills.
- A creative approach, with the ability to develop engaging marketing content and promotional campaigns.
- Experience using marketing tools such as Canva, email marketing platforms and content management systems.
- Good organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
- A proactive, self-motivated approach and the confidence to work independently.
- The ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across different departments.

Experience within trade, B2 B marketing, retail, interiors, home improvement or other consumer-facing environments would be advantageous, although we're equally interested in candidates from other sectors with relevant transferable skills.

Knowledge of WordPress, Adobe Creative Suite, basic graphic design or video content creation would also be beneficial, but isn't essential.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £30,000-£36,000, depending on experience.
- The opportunity to join an established business experiencing significant growth and investment.
- A varied, hands-on marketing role covering multiple channels and campaigns.
- Genuine responsibility and ownership of your own marketing activities.
- The opportunity to contribute ideas and help shape future marketing initiatives.
- A supportive, collaborative team environment with a management style that encourages initiative and independent thinking.
- Opportunities to develop your skills as the business continues to expand its digital presence and marketing activities.

Interested?

title: Marketing Coordinator (HubSpot)
description:
GBR Recruitment Ltd are delighted to working exclusively with a leading design, manufacturing & installation business based between Leicester & Derby, recruiting for an experienced Marketing Coordinator who is really strong in using HubSpot / AI tools for managing all marketing activities across the business.

The key focus for this Marketing Coordination role is utilising HubSpot to its full potential to help reach those audiences the client wants to capture in order to secure new sales.

You will update & manage HubSpot in terms of the stored data, segmentation of sales targets, campaign records, workflows for marketing, campaign preparation & delivery, drafting marketing collateral with AI tools, produce landing pages & more.

You will also get the chance to be creative developing marketing campaign ideas that are innovative & eye catching, plus managing social media channels such as X (Twitter), Instagram, TikTok, Facebook & LinkedIn.

You will also coordinate videography & photography activities promoting the works the business carries out & producing previous installation case studies.

Traditional marketing activities will also be undertaken in the form of graphics, brochures, POS stands, digital assets & more.

HubSpot, data & AI tasks (large % of the role, key focus on this):
- Maintain and Manage HubSpot for marketing, keeping contact data, audience segments and campaign records accurate and up to date.
- Develop and maintain marketing workflows across email campaigns, event follow-ups and nurturing contacts who have shown interest in the companies products / solutions.
- Set up and manage AI agents to support recurring marketing tasks.
- Use AI to draft and tailor marketing emails for different sectors.
- Reviewing marketing copy for accuracy and ensuring the brand tone of voice is correct and in line with other marketing activity, before it goes live to the open markets.
- Keep up to date all marketing forms and landing pages in HubSpot so enquiries can be tracked back to the campaigns that generated them.
- Produce reports showing campaign performance levels, including email engagement, enquiries and conversion rates, and use the findings to improve future campaigns.

Creative Campaigns & Social Media Activities (smaller % of the role)
- Create innovative marketing campaign ideas across industrial, commercial and other sectors the company supplies into.
- Successfully manage the social media calendar, writing and scheduling posts for LinkedIn and other relevant channels.
- Book in and oversee all customer sites photography, filming and customer interviews, turning completed projects into case studies, testimonials and short videos.
- Produce all branded graphics, brochures and associated digital assets that show how customers use the companies products.

The Marketing Coordinator role is commutable from areas such as Castle Donington, Ashby de la Zouch, Swadlincote, Derby, Burton on Trent & Coalville, plus areas close to these.

The role will be a mix of office based & hybrid working (flex).

This position could suit someone working as a Marketing Coordinator, Marketing Administrator, Marketing Executive, Marketing Associate, Marketing & Events Coordinator, HubSpot Admin & Email Marketing Specialist, HubSpot Administrator, HubSpot Coordinator, CRM Coordinator, or similar roles to these in Marketing.

The client is looking to hire ASAP, so if you are based within a commutable distance of Derby & Leicester (ideally somewhere in between the 2 locations) then apply today!

title: Performance Marketing Manager
company: Macildowie Recruitment and Retention - Agency - Permanent
description:
Digital Performance Manager

Hybrid, Loughborough,

09:00 - 17:00, Monday to Friday

Up to £40,000

Macildowie are working with this client based in Loughborough, a rapidly growing, commercially focused digital marketing agency specialising in performance marketing, SEO, Paid Media and integrated marketing solutions.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced Digital Performance Manager to take ownership of performance across a diverse client portfolio, combining strategic oversight with hands-on Paid Media delivery.

If you're an experienced digital marketing professional who enjoys analysing performance, challenging strategy, developing specialists and delivering measurable commercial results, this could be an excellent next step.

The Role

Working closely with senior leadership, account teams and channel specialists, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring SEO and Paid Media activity consistently delivers against client objectives.

You'll provide strategic direction, maintain high reporting standards and support client relationships, while retaining the opportunity to manage and optimise Paid Media campaigns directly.

Key Responsibilities:
- Oversee SEO and Paid Media performance across multiple client accounts.
- Review and challenge channel strategies to ensure activity supports commercial objectives.
- Identify underperforming campaigns and implement clear optimisation and recovery plans.
- Monitor performance KPIs, campaign budgets, account health and emerging risks.
- Act as a senior point of contact for clients, leading performance reviews and strategic discussions.
- Support account teams with performance-related client concerns and escalations.
- Review client reports, ensuring accuracy, actionable insights and clear recommendations.
- Develop and maintain quality assurance standards across digital performance delivery.
- Mentor and support SEO and Paid Media specialists, with the opportunity to develop formal line management responsibilities.
- Oversee external digital marketing resources and manage workload priorities.
- Plan, launch, manage and optimise Paid Media campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads and other relevant platforms.
- Review account structures, targeting, budgets, conversion performance and campaign efficiency.
- Support campaign troubleshooting, testing and optimisation where additional delivery expertise is required.

About You

We're looking for a commercially minded digital performance specialist who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on campaign delivery.

Essential Experience:
- Strong digital performance marketing experience gained within an agency environment.
- Significant hands-on Paid Media experience, particularly across Google Ads and Meta Ads.
- A strong strategic understanding of SEO and how it contributes to wider marketing performance.
- Experience managing multiple client accounts and campaign budgets.
- Confidence analysing campaign performance and translating data into commercial recommendations.
- Experience reviewing and developing digital marketing strategies.
- Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills.
- Experience mentoring, supporting or managing other team members.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- A proactive, collaborative approach to improving performance and maintaining high standards.

Desirable Experience:
- Previous experience as a Digital Performance Manager, Senior Paid Media Manager or similar.
- Experience with Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads or TikTok Ads.
- Knowledge of GA4, Google Search Console and conversion tracking.
- Experience working across both B2 B and B2 C campaigns.
- Exposure to ecommerce and lead generation accounts.
- Experience managing external specialists or outsourced resources.
- Understanding of attribution, analytics and multi-channel reporting.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary of £35,000-£40,000 per annum.
- Company pension.
- Free on-site parking.
- Potential home-working flexibility, subject to confirmation.
- The opportunity to influence digital performance strategy across a growing client portfolio.
- Exposure to varied clients, industries and performance marketing challenges.
- The chance to mentor and develop channel specialists.
- A key role in shaping the future of a growing digital marketing function.
- A collaborative and commercially focused agency environment.

Interested?

If you're an experienced Paid Media professional with a strong understanding of SEO, a passion for performance and the confidence to lead strategic client conversations, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact Macildowie for a confidential discussion about this opportunity.
